On a weekday morning a certain telephone switchboard receives an average
of twenty five calls during a five minute period. Find the probabilities that

and 10.32 next Thursday morning; [3 mafks ]

-random sample of 10 washers is chosen which has a mean thickness of

confident that the candidate will be elected if 55% of the sample are in
favour of the candidate? [10 marks]
